summary: Alpha Compute Corp filed a Form 6-K reporting the completion of its acquisition of a 60% controlling equity interest in GaMee Global from Animoca Brands. Total upfront consideration was $3.5 million: $1.5 million cash and $2.0 million in equity (99,800 ordinary shares and pre-funded warrants for 1,900,200 shares at $1.00/share). The board recommendation and advisor are not named. A shareholders' agreement governs ownership and management; Alpha Compute nominated two of three directors. The transaction closed on May 27, 2026, with audited financials and pro forma statements provided. Watch for integration execution and any earnout or milestone payments.
